POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

APP_USER.description: Dedicated application database role created during first initialization.

APP_DB.description: Application database created during first initialization of an empty PostgreSQL volume.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Generated password for the application database role. Preserve it with your backups.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

ENABLE_VECTOR.description: Initialize the pgvector extension for applications that require vector storage. Keep the supplied value.

ALLOW_APP_DATABASE_CREATION.description: Grant database and role creation privileges required by ToolJet. Keep false for other applications.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

NODE_ENV.description: Node.js runtime mode. Keep production for hosted deployments.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

HOSTNAME.description: Application bind address. Keep 0.0.0.0 for container networking.

WEBAPP_URL.description: Public Formbricks HTTPS URL. Update together with NEXTAUTH_URL when changing domains.

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public authentication callback base URL. Keep equal to WEBAPP_URL.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Generated authentication signing secret. Preserve across restarts and backup restores.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated Formbricks encryption key. Back it up securely; changing it can make encrypted data unreadable.

CRON_SECRET.description: Generated secret authorizing Formbricks scheduled maintenance endpoints. Keep private.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

HUB_API_KEY.description: Generated authentication key shared with the private Hub service. Keep the service references aligned.

HUB_API_URL.description: Private Hub API base URL. Automatically references the hub service.

CUBEJS_API_URL.description: Private Cube analytics API URL. Automatically references the cube service.

CUBEJS_API_SECRET.description: Shared generated Cube analytics signing secret. Preserve the matching app and Cube references.

CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER.description: Expected issuer for Formbricks analytics tokens. Keep the app and Cube values identical.

CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for Formbricks analytics tokens. Keep the app and Cube values identical.

EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DISABLED.description: Email verification is initially disabled. Set to 0 only after configuring and testing SMTP delivery.

PASSWORD_RESET_DISABLED.description: Password reset is initially disabled. Set to 0 after configuring and testing SMTP delivery.

TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Disable application telemetry. Keep 1 to retain this privacy default.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

API_KEY.description: Generated API authentication key, or a reference to the shared internal API key. Keep private and preserve matching references.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

CUBEJS_DB_TYPE.description: Cube database driver. Keep postgres for this deployment.

CUBEJS_DB_HOST.description: Private PostgreSQL hostname used by Cube analytics.

CUBEJS_DB_NAME.description: Formbricks database queried by Cube analytics.

CUBEJS_DB_USER.description: Application database role used by Cube analytics.

CUBEJS_DB_PASS.description: Reference to the generated application database password used by Cube.

CUBEJS_DB_PORT.description: Private PostgreSQL port used by Cube. Keep 5432.

CUBEJS_API_SECRET.description: Shared generated Cube analytics signing secret. Preserve the matching app and Cube references.

CUBEJS_JWT_ISSUER.description: Expected issuer for Formbricks analytics tokens. Keep the app and Cube values identical.

CUBEJS_JWT_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for Formbricks analytics tokens. Keep the app and Cube values identical.

CUBEJS_DEFAULT_API_SCOPES.description: Cube API scopes enabled for analytics requests. Keep the upstream-compatible default.

CUBEJS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.description: Cube external pre-aggregation storage toggle. Keep the supplied default for this topology.

CUBEJS_CACHE_AND_QUEUE_DRIVER.description: Cube cache/queue driver. Uses memory in this single-service deployment.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
